label: Task-26
title: Add expandable error details in Messages Panel
description:
Add a 'Show Details' toggle for error messages in the Messages Panel, similar to the API Explorer's request details.

## Requirements
1. Error messages should have a 'Show Details' link/button
2. Details should be hidden by default
3. When expanded, show:
   - Full error message
   - Stack trace (if available)
   - Request URL (if API error)
   - Response status code
   - Timestamp
4. Collapsible - can hide details again
5. Style consistent with Messages Panel theme

## UI Mockup
```
[ERROR] updateNode failed: Not Found      [x]
ERROR - just now
[Show Details v]

--- Expanded ---
[ERROR] updateNode failed: Not Found      [x]
ERROR - just now
[Hide Details ^]
  URL: PATCH /nodes/api/nodes/Bug-11
  Status: 404 Not Found
  Stack: at GraphService._fetch (graph-service.js:386)
         at async GraphService.updateNode...
  Time: 2024-02-02 10:15:32
```

## Implementation
- Store error details in message object
- Add toggle button to message rendering
- CSS for details section (monospace, dimmed)
